shortdescription.en: Free software CUPS driver for the KONICA MINOLTA (Minolta) Dialta Di1610 GDI laser printer

comments.en: CUPS filter (rastertokm4) and PPD for the host-based "KM4" GDI protocol of the Di1610, reverse-engineered from the Windows driver. A4 only, 600 and 300 dpi. Packaged as printer-driver-di1610 where available. The scanner is not supported.
